name: Byte Padding 1 Code
definition: Byte padding for a cypher block chaining mode encryption, if the padding is not implicit.

LNGT.name: Length Padding
LNGT.definition: Message to encrypt is completed by a byte value containing the total number of added bytes.

NUL8.name: Null 80 Padding
NUL8.definition: Message to encrypt is completed by one bit of value 1, followed by null bits until the encryption block length is reached.

NULG.name: Null Length Padding
NULG.definition: Message to encrypt is completed by null byte values, the last byte containing the total number of added bytes.

NULL.name: Null Padding
NULL.definition: Message to encrypt is completed by null bytes.

RAND.name: Random Padding
RAND.definition: Message to encrypt is completed by random value, the last byte containing the total number of added bytes.
